notes.title: The Road to 1.0!
notes.content:
Thanks for playing!
We got a lot of good feedback from our demo/playtest that was available during Steam Next Fest. We also had a lot of fun playing with all of you! Now we're going to take down the demo so we can focus on the main build and get it ready for release!


The Path to 1.0
All of the major systems are in the game, so what we have left is adding more content! And of course polishing and fixing bugs.

So our next steps are to revamp some of the systems that had issues in the demo. Mainly the menus and the customization. The menus were just a little clunky behind the scenes, so the plan is to write a proper menu state system so there's no more issues of menus popping up over other menus. And the customization system got a bit confused as to what items went on which pigeon lol. So we're going to make that way better.

As far as content, we need to add maps, weapons, customizations and emotes. And that's probably in order of difficulty/time to create. Maps and weapons take a lot of work to create and refine. So that'll be most of the time.

And we just generally need to market the game more.


Plan for Release
Our current hope is to release War Pigeons 1.0 in Q4 of 2025. But realistically it'll probably Q1 of 2026. And a lot of this will probably depend on how many eyes we can get on the game before then. And we will need some testers along the way, so if you're interested in getting to play the game early and in helping us make it better, you can join our discord and inquire about testing! We'd love to have you.


Maps
This is some concept art for 2 new maps. We have The Sewers, which will have toxic sludge that pours in intervals and will damage Pigeons who pass through it. Then we have Cloud City, which will have spinning blades, bouncy clouds, and platforms that move as well as blow you in different directions! Keep in mind this is concept art, not the final visuals or layouts for the maps.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634294/20d4dcbde957d7237e92f4110a8cd84b9630dede.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45634294/7f166234ae6ad6e8428d93842654c85d6091d007.png"][/carousel]Weapons
And here we have some new weapon concepts. First we have the The Butt Bomb where your pigeon will fall with dramatic force and damage any pigeons in the way. The Rock Launcher, which is pretty self explanatory, but it'll have some fun kickback to deal with. And finally, The Tank, where your Pigeon will pilot a Tank, pulling you from the sky and letting you roam around the ground, firing at those pesky Pigeons up there.
